2053. Binary Search Tree - Find Minimum and Maximum

70

Problem Statement
Create a Binary Search Tree from given integers and find the minimum and maximum values stored in the tree.
Description
Read n integers and insert them into a Binary Search Tree. Find the minimum value by following left child links and the maximum value by following right child links. Print both values.
input_spec: The first line contains an integer n. The second line contains n space-separated integers to be inserted into the Binary Search Tree.
output_spec: Print the minimum value on the first line and the maximum value on the second line.
